g.text: compact: calendar and agenda scroll together
Planning and Overview share appointments, medications and the events the patient confirmed through ObservePlanning.
Events are optional: if they can't be read, appointments and medications still show. A caregiver gets medications and events only if the patient also shares Prescriptions and Events.
Appointment rows and the next-appointment card open AppointmentDetailScreen, event rows open EventDetailScreen; Back returns to the origin.
US-35: Planning → MedicationDetailScreen → PrescriptionDetailScreen; Back keeps the selected day.
